_note: Paste-ready catalog entries for the DopamineDesk x402 Marketplace (jblaz6335/mcp-server-aidatamarketplace). Shape mirrors the product objects discovery.js consumes (operation_id, name, use_when, description, price_usdc, source, example_request, input_parameters). Prices verified live from our 402 challenges 2026-10-21 (token-report 10000 units=$0.010, gate/swap 8000 units=$0.008, token-security 9000 units=$0.009 — Base USDC, 6 decimals). Settlement pays our wallet 0x5765ae06a52dc7A0BB71c36A11db512c7ea9ed10 directly via standard x402 v2 exact scheme on Base mainnet (eip155:8453) through Coinbase CDP — same flow DopamineDesk already uses. Our 402 manifest is at https://x402-data-api.sigrunner.workers.dev/.well-known/x402 so your live-OpenAPI loader can also auto-ingest.

products.name: Grey Ridge Swap Safety Gate (Base)
products.use_when: An autonomous trading agent needs a GO / HOLD / BLOCK decision right before a Base ERC-20 swap.
products.description: Pre-trade GO/HOLD/BLOCK gate for a Base ERC-20 swap. Combines honeypot/sellability simulation, admin-control checks (mint/pause/blacklist/fee-setter/upgradeable-proxy, owner-renounced) and Uniswap v3 WETH-pool liquidity vs. your trade size (price-impact guard). Returns one decision + reason + risk_score. Pairs with DopamineDesk transaction-preflight.

input_parameters.name: ref
input_parameters.description: referral tag — set to dopaminedesk so settled calls are attributed to you for reconcile

products.name: Grey Ridge Token Trade-Safety Report (Base)
products.use_when: An agent or buyer wants a full SAFE/CAUTION/AVOID verdict on a Base token before holding or trading it.
products.description: Base ERC-20 trade-safety verdict in one call: SAFE | CAUTION | AVOID + risk_score (0-100) + reasons. Bundles honeypot/sellability simulation, owner-renounced + mint/pause/blacklist/fee-setter/upgradeable-proxy checks, measured transfer tax, symbol/name/decimals, and Uniswap v3 WETH-pool liquidity (USD). Pairs with DopamineDesk token-audit.

input_parameters.name: ref
input_parameters.description: referral tag — set to dopaminedesk for attributed reconcile

products.name: Grey Ridge Token Security Analysis (Base)
products.use_when: An agent needs the deep per-check security breakdown for a single Base token (not just the summary verdict).
products.description: Full security analysis for a Base ERC-20: per-check honeypot/sellability, admin controls, tax mutability, proxy/upgradeability, LP lock/liquidity. Returns the itemized evidence behind the verdict.

input_parameters.name: ref
input_parameters.description: referral tag — set to dopaminedesk for attributed reconcile
